s0301.literal: On wushen day Prince Kuanche was enfeoffed Prince of Su.
s0301.idiomatic: On wushen day Prince Kuanche was enfeoffed Prince of Su.

s0302.literal: On jiyou day the imperial carriage departed Shangdu.
s0302.idiomatic: On jiyou day the imperial carriage departed Shangdu.

s0303.literal: One thousand eight hundred thirty guards who came north with Mingzong were each granted fifty ingots of notes; twelve qeshig officers were each granted two hundred ingots of notes;
s0303.idiomatic: 1,830 guards who came north with Mingzong were each granted 50 ingots of notes; 12 qeshig officers were each granted 200 ingots of notes;

s0304.literal: followers who had gone on campaign were each granted two bolts of silks and cloths and sent back.
s0304.idiomatic: Followers who had gone on campaign were each granted 2 bolts of silks and cloths and sent back.

s0305.literal: Xin Prefecture in Jining Route, after warfare, suffered repeated famine; one thousand ingots of notes were issued for relief.
s0305.idiomatic: Xin Prefecture in Jining Route, after warfare, suffered repeated famine; 1,000 ingots of notes were issued for relief.

s0306.literal: On gengxu day the Crown Prince's Household was renamed the Stored Governance Court; Bayan concurrently served as superintendent of stored governance; Central Domestic Affairs Court commissioner Qasar Buqa, crown prince household vice director Xiaoyun Shimusi, and former superintendent of stored blessings Yao Wei were all made superintendents of stored governance.
s0306.idiomatic: On gengxu day the Crown Prince's Household was renamed the Stored Governance Court; Bayan concurrently served as superintendent of stored governance; Central Domestic Affairs Court commissioner Qasar Buqa, crown prince household vice director Xiaoyun Shimusi, and former superintendent of stored blessings Yao Wei were all made superintendents of stored governance.

s0307.literal: Hedong Branch Commission consolation commissioner Hasan, under the pretext of court congratulations, collected one thousand ingots of notes belonging to his jurisdiction for himself; when the matter was discovered, although a general amnesty had occurred, the notes were still levied and returned to their owners.
s0307.idiomatic: Hedong Branch Commission consolation commissioner Hasan, under the pretext of court congratulations, collected 1,000 ingots of notes belonging to his jurisdiction for himself; when the matter was discovered, although a general amnesty had occurred, the notes were still levied and returned to their owners.

s0308.literal: An edict: from now on those who collect notes under the pretext of court congratulations shall be punished according to the law on perverting the law.
s0308.idiomatic: An edict: from now on those who collect notes under the pretext of court congratulations shall be punished according to the law on perverting the law.

s0309.literal: On guichou day Prince of Wu Pobi and his uncles Munanzi were summoned to the capital.
s0309.idiomatic: On guichou day Prince of Wu Pobi and his uncles Munanzi were summoned to the capital.

s0310.literal: On jiayin day the Longxiang General Directorate was established, rank upper third grade, to oversee construction labor for Great Chengtian Huguo Temple.
s0310.idiomatic: On jiayin day the Longxiang General Directorate was established, rank upper third grade, to oversee construction labor for Great Chengtian Huguo Temple.

s0311.literal: Surveillance censor impeached: "Former chancellor Biebuhua was formerly dismissed for corruption; at the start of Tianli, by riding others' success he thereupon occupied the chancellorship.
s0311.idiomatic: Surveillance censor impeached: "Former chancellor Biebuhua was formerly dismissed for corruption; at the start of Tianli, by riding others' success he thereupon occupied the chancellorship.

s0312.literal: He both forged an edict to grant the property of the donkey-buying household to grand councillor Susu, and secretly summoned diviners with Susu and others to calculate the sacred lifespan.
s0312.idiomatic: He both forged an edict to grant the property of the donkey-buying household to grand councillor Susu, and secretly summoned diviners with Susu and others to calculate the sacred lifespan.

s0313.literal: Now, having received an edict releasing his crime, he should be exiled to the sea islands, to cut off wicked beginnings.
s0313.idiomatic: Now, having received an edict releasing his crime, he should be exiled to the sea islands, to cut off wicked beginnings.

s0314.literal: " The Emperor said: "Exiling to sea islands — We cannot bear it; let him together with his wife and children be placed at Jiqing.
s0314.idiomatic: " The Emperor said: "Exiling to sea islands — We cannot bear it; let him together with his wife and children be placed at Jiqing.

s0315.literal: " Henan Prefecture Route suffered drought and epidemic, and also warfare; relief was provided with three months' grain from that prefecture's garrison-field rents and from Anfeng Office relay transport grain.
s0315.idiomatic: " Henan Prefecture Route suffered drought and epidemic, and also warfare; relief was provided with 3 months' grain from that prefecture's garrison-field rents and from Anfeng Office relay transport grain.

s0316.literal: Ju, Mi, and Yi prefectures — starving people gathered tree and grass seeds, and bandits increased daily; relief was provided with twenty-one thousand shi of rice, and Jinning Route starving people were also relieved with ten thousand ingots of notes.
s0316.idiomatic: Ju, Mi, and Yi prefectures — starving people gathered tree and grass seeds, and bandits increased daily; relief was provided with 21,000 shi of rice, and Jinning Route starving people were also relieved with 10,000 ingots of notes.

s0317.literal: Subordinate counties of Daming, Zhending, and Hejian, and Hu, Chi, and Rao routes suffered drought; Xingtang County in Baoding had locusts.
s0317.idiomatic: Subordinate counties of Daming, Zhending, and Hejian, and Hu, Chi, and Rao routes suffered drought; Xingtang County in Baoding had locusts.

s0318.literal: The god of Dadu city wall and moat was further enfeoffed Prince Protect-the-State and Preserve-Tranquility; his consort was enfeoffed Princess Protect-the-State and Preserve-Tranquility.
s0318.idiomatic: The god of Dadu city wall and moat was further enfeoffed Prince Protect-the-State and Preserve-Tranquility; his consort was enfeoffed Princess Protect-the-State and Preserve-Tranquility.

s0319.literal: Ninth month, on the yimao new moon, Buddhist rites were performed at the Hall of Great Brightness, Xingsheng, and Longfu palaces.
s0319.idiomatic: Ninth month, on the yimao new moon, Buddhist rites were performed at the Hall of Great Brightness, Xingsheng, and Longfu palaces.

s0320.literal: Land of former Song empress dowager Lady Quan was purchased as perpetual endowment for Great Chengtian Huguo Temple.
s0320.idiomatic: Land of former Song empress dowager Lady Quan was purchased as perpetual endowment for Great Chengtian Huguo Temple.

s0321.literal: On wuwu day Prince Wuning Chechequ was granted one hundred taels of gold and five hundred taels of silver; Western Regions prince Yenzhijitai was granted two thousand five hundred taels of gold and fifteen thousand taels of silver; notes and silks according to difference.
s0321.idiomatic: On wuwu day Prince Wuning Chechequ was granted 100 taels of gold and 500 taels of silver; Western Regions prince Yenzhijitai was granted 2,500 taels of gold and 15,000 taels of silver; notes and silks according to difference.

s0322.literal: On jiwei day the Longxiang and Wanshou construction and maintenance intendant offices and Hainan construction and maintenance intendant office were established, all rank upper fourth grade, subordinate to Longxiang General Directorate.
s0322.idiomatic: On jiwei day the Longxiang and Wanshou construction and maintenance intendant offices and Hainan construction and maintenance intendant office were established, all rank upper fourth grade, subordinate to Longxiang General Directorate.

s0323.literal: On gengshen day deceased overseer of Daoist affairs in all routes Zhang Liushun was further enfeoffed as supreme minister, grand master, Assistant Completion Enthusiastic Transformation Preservation-of-Fortune Divine Virtue True Lord.
s0323.idiomatic: On gengshen day deceased overseer of Daoist affairs in all routes Zhang Liushun was further enfeoffed as supreme minister, grand master, Assistant Completion Enthusiastic Transformation Preservation-of-Fortune Divine Virtue True Lord.

s0324.literal: On xinyou day, all officials who had gone to Mingzong's whereabouts bearing the imperial seal and had been promoted out of turn were demoted accordingly.
s0324.idiomatic: On xinyou day, all officials who had gone to Mingzong's whereabouts bearing the imperial seal and had been promoted out of turn were demoted accordingly.

s0325.literal: Gansu Branch Secretariat relay stations including Shazhou and Chaba were each relieved with one thousand five hundred ingots of notes.
s0325.idiomatic: Gansu Branch Secretariat relay stations including Shazhou and Chaba were each relieved with 1,500 ingots of notes.

s0326.literal: On guihai day an edict: gold, silver, notes, and silks stored by the Palace Provision Office — the hundred offices may not memorialize requesting them.
s0326.idiomatic: On guihai day an edict: gold, silver, notes, and silks stored by the Palace Provision Office — the hundred offices may not memorialize requesting them.

s0327.literal: On jiazi day native official Luzhu of Wusa in Yunnan and native official Jujing of Qujing were each granted one set of robes.
s0327.idiomatic: On jiazi day native official Luzhu of Wusa in Yunnan and native official Jujing of Qujing were each granted 1 set of robes.

s0328.literal: On dingmao day the grand carriage arrived at Dadu.
s0328.idiomatic: On dingmao day the grand carriage arrived at Dadu.

s0329.literal: On wuchen day an edict: Hanlin National History Academy officials together with Kui Zhang Pavilion academicians are to collect and compile institutions of this dynasty, following the Tang and Song Huiyao, and compose them as the Comprehensive Institutions for Governing the Age.
s0329.idiomatic: On wuchen day an edict: Hanlin National History Academy officials together with Kui Zhang Pavilion academicians are to collect and compile institutions of this dynasty, following the Tang and Song Huiyao, and compose them as the Comprehensive Institutions for Governing the Age.

s0330.literal: Prince of Weishun Kuanchibuhua was summoned to court.
s0330.idiomatic: Prince of Weishun Kuanchibuhua was summoned to court.

s0331.literal: An edict: "Envoys who proclaim amnesty edicts shall on average travel more than three hundred li per day.
s0331.idiomatic: An edict: "Envoys who proclaim amnesty edicts shall on average travel more than 300 li per day.

s0332.literal: After receiving their commission, those who delay three days or, upon arrival, feast and exceed the deadline shall be punished; those who accept bribes shall be judged according to the law on perverting the law.
s0332.idiomatic: After receiving their commission, those who delay 3 days or, upon arrival, feast and exceed the deadline shall be punished; those who accept bribes shall be judged according to the law on perverting the law.

s0333.literal: " On xinwei day twenty crane-controlling guardsmen were granted to Prince Xuanjing Mainu.
s0333.idiomatic: " On xinwei day 20 crane-controlling guardsmen were granted to Prince Xuanjing Mainu.

s0334.literal: Surveillance censor impeached: "Privy council administrator Tash Temür fawned upon Doresh, and also joined Wang Chan in raising troops to violate the capital.
s0334.idiomatic: Surveillance censor impeached: "Privy council administrator Tash Temür fawned upon Doresh, and also joined Wang Chan in raising troops to violate the capital.

s0335.literal: Now that he has been spared death, yet military authority is again entrusted to him — this is not expedient.
s0335.idiomatic: Now that he has been spared death, yet military authority is again entrusted to him — this is not expedient.

s0336.literal: " An edict removed him from office.
s0336.idiomatic: " An edict removed him from office.

s0337.literal: On renshen day qeshig officer Director of Military Stores Dingzhu was specially granted the same trappings as the Three Excellencies of an opened princely household.
s0337.idiomatic: On renshen day qeshig officer Director of Military Stores Dingzhu was specially granted the same trappings as the Three Excellencies of an opened princely household.

s0338.literal: On guiyou day the Emperor presided at the Hall of Great Brightness and received homage from princes and the hundred officials.
s0338.idiomatic: On guiyou day the Emperor presided at the Hall of Great Brightness and received homage from princes and the hundred officials.

s0339.literal: The sons of Tiemudie'er including Suoci — Mingzong had once ordered them exiled to the south; Yan Temür said Suoci had meritorious service to the state at the start of Tianli and requested each be sent back to his home district — approved.
s0339.idiomatic: The sons of Tiemudie'er including Suoci — Mingzong had once ordered them exiled to the south; Yan Temür said Suoci had meritorious service to the state at the start of Tianli and requested each be sent back to his home district — approved.

s0340.literal: On jiaxu day Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat was ordered next year to transport two million eight hundred thousand shi of grain tribute to the capital.
s0340.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat was ordered next year to transport 2,800,000 shi of grain tribute to the capital.

s0341.literal: Guangxi Siming Prefecture native official Huang Zongyong dispatched his son to present tribute of tigers, leopards, and local products.
s0341.idiomatic: Guangxi Siming Prefecture native official Huang Zongyong dispatched his son to present tribute of tigers, leopards, and local products.

s0342.literal: On yihai day Shi Weiliang submitted a memorial saying: "Today many commanderies and districts throughout the realm suffer disasters; state expenditures are so heavy, the treasury is empty, and the people are wasted and afflicted — this is the time when government is renewed and a hundred neglected matters restored.
s0342.idiomatic: On yihai day Shi Weiliang submitted a memorial saying: "Today many commanderies and districts throughout the realm suffer disasters; state expenditures are so heavy, the treasury is empty, and the people are wasted and afflicted — this is the time when government is renewed and a hundred neglected matters restored.

s0343.literal: It is fitting to follow Emperor Shizu's settled statutes, eliminate redundant persons who parasitically consume, abolish construction projects not urgently needed, and everywhere rectify matters that are not expedient.
s0343.idiomatic: It is fitting to follow Emperor Shizu's settled statutes, eliminate redundant persons who parasitically consume, abolish construction projects not urgently needed, and everywhere rectify matters that are not expedient.

s0344.literal: Thus calamities from Heaven may be quelled and auspicious omens may be attained.
s0344.idiomatic: Thus calamities from Heaven may be quelled and auspicious omens may be attained.

s0345.literal: Otherwise, I fear that following the course of careless makeshift, evils will gradually deepen, and the source of order and disorder will from this be divided.
s0345.idiomatic: Otherwise, I fear that following the course of careless makeshift, evils will gradually deepen, and the source of order and disorder will from this be divided.

s0346.literal: " The Emperor commended and accepted it.
s0346.idiomatic: " The Emperor commended and accepted it.

s0347.literal: On bingzi day the Grand Blessings Court was renamed the Grand Blessings Ancestral Sacrifice Court.
s0347.idiomatic: On bingzi day the Grand Blessings Court was renamed the Grand Blessings Ancestral Sacrifice Court.

s0348.literal: Wenzhou Route Bamboo and Timber Depot was established.
s0348.idiomatic: Wenzhou Route Bamboo and Timber Depot was established.

s0349.literal: Because Weihui Route suffered drought, Su Gate's annual delivery of two thousand shi of rice was remitted.
s0349.idiomatic: Because Weihui Route suffered drought, Su Gate's annual delivery of 2,000 shi of rice was remitted.

s0350.literal: Temür Buqhua was additionally granted authority over weighty military and state affairs.
s0350.idiomatic: Temür Buqhua was additionally granted authority over weighty military and state affairs.

s0351.literal: Hanlin academician expositor Ye'erjini and marshal Duke of Liang Duolienie were both made to concurrently administer mobile privy council affairs.
s0351.idiomatic: Hanlin academician expositor Ye'erjini and marshal Duke of Liang Duolienie were both made to concurrently administer mobile privy council affairs.

s0352.literal: The Guard Commandant Office was established, rank upper fourth grade, subordinate to the Stored Governance Court.
s0352.idiomatic: The Guard Commandant Office was established, rank upper fourth grade, subordinate to the Stored Governance Court.

s0353.literal: Shaanxi relay stations including Lintong — twenty-three in all — were each relieved with five hundred ingots of notes.
s0353.idiomatic: Shaanxi relay stations including Lintong — 23 in all — were each relieved with 500 ingots of notes.

s0354.literal: Yesianier was judged for disloyalty and disrespect and was executed.
s0354.idiomatic: Yesianier was judged for disloyalty and disrespect and was executed.

s0355.literal: Followers of princes including Balama and Quduhuozhe dwelling in Lan, Guan, and Lin prefectures took advantage of disorder to become bandits; branch secretariat, censorate, and clan prince registrar officials were dispatched to supervise the relevant offices in capturing and punishing them.
s0355.idiomatic: Followers of princes including Balama and Quduhuozhe dwelling in Lan, Guan, and Lin prefectures took advantage of disorder to become bandits; branch secretariat, censorate, and clan prince registrar officials were dispatched to supervise the relevant offices in capturing and punishing them.

s0356.literal: On renwu day Bayan, being ill and on leave, resided at Chicheng; envoys were dispatched to summon him to court.
s0356.idiomatic: On renwu day Bayan, being ill and on leave, resided at Chicheng; envoys were dispatched to summon him to court.

s0357.literal: Privy council administrator Yanbuq was enfeoffed Duke of Xing; grand minister of agriculture Yenchi was made minister of works.
s0357.idiomatic: Privy council administrator Yanbuq was enfeoffed Duke of Xing; grand minister of agriculture Yenchi was made minister of works.

s0358.literal: On guiwei day a temple to Master Yan was built at the humble lane in Qufu where he had dwelt.
s0358.idiomatic: On guiwei day a temple to Master Yan was built at the humble lane in Qufu where he had dwelt.

s0359.literal: West of Shangdu at Ataqan and Kuqqanqulatu, because of warfare and drought the people reported famine; one month's grain was issued for relief.
s0359.idiomatic: West of Shangdu at Ataqan and Kuqqanqulatu, because of warfare and drought the people reported famine; 1 month's grain was issued for relief.

s0360.literal: Winter, tenth month, on the jiashen new moon, the Emperor wore sacrificial robes and cap and offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0360.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, on the jiashen new moon, the Emperor wore sacrificial robes and cap and offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0361.literal: On bingxu day the Qipchaq Guard was ordered concurrently to administer the Expenditure Supervisory Office; Prince of Zhennan Borag Buqa was dispatched back to garrison Yangzhou.
s0361.idiomatic: On bingxu day the Qipchaq Guard was ordered concurrently to administer the Expenditure Supervisory Office; Prince of Zhennan Borag Buqa was dispatched back to garrison Yangzhou.

s0362.literal: Wine-brewing was forbidden in Fengyuan and Yongping.
s0362.idiomatic: Wine-brewing was forbidden in Fengyuan and Yongping.

s0363.literal: On wuzi day privy council administrator Prince Zhaowu Hosha was made to administer mobile privy council affairs.
s0363.idiomatic: On wuzi day privy council administrator Prince Zhaowu Hosha was made to administer mobile privy council affairs.

s0364.literal: On jichou day the Great Chengtian Huguo Temple construction and maintenance intendant office was established, rank upper fifth grade;
s0364.idiomatic: On jichou day the Great Chengtian Huguo Temple construction and maintenance intendant office was established, rank upper fifth grade;

s0365.literal: two field-tax intendant offices for Dadu and other places and Pingjiang and other places were also established, rank lower fifth grade;
s0365.idiomatic: 2 field-tax intendant offices for Dadu and other places and Pingjiang and other places were also established, rank lower fifth grade;

s0366.literal: all subordinate to Longxiang General Directorate.
s0366.idiomatic: All were subordinate to Longxiang General Directorate.

s0367.literal: On xinmao day Yan Temür led the hundred ministers to request an honorific title — not granted.
s0367.idiomatic: On xinmao day Yan Temür led the hundred ministers to request an honorific title — not granted.

s0368.literal: Yunnan Branch Secretariat established consolation commissions including Yuanjiang.
s0368.idiomatic: Yunnan Branch Secretariat established consolation commissions including Yuanjiang.

s0369.literal: Admonitions were issued regarding prohibitions on sea-route grain transport.
s0369.idiomatic: Admonitions were issued regarding prohibitions on sea-route grain transport.

s0370.literal: Sichuan Nangjiatai's household property was registered; his faction including Yang Jing were all stripped of rank, flogged one hundred seven strokes, their households registered, and exiled to Liaodong.
s0370.idiomatic: Sichuan Nangjiatai's household property was registered; his faction including Yang Jing were all stripped of rank, flogged 107 strokes, their households registered, and exiled to Liaodong.

s0371.literal: Superintendent of Grand Blessings Ancestral Sacrifice Tughan Temür was enfeoffed Duke of Liang.
s0371.idiomatic: Superintendent of Grand Blessings Ancestral Sacrifice Tughan Temür was enfeoffed Duke of Liang.

s0372.literal: On jiawu day, in grateful acknowledgment of accession, officials were dispatched to perform sacrifices by proxy at the southern suburban altar and altars of soil and grain.
s0372.idiomatic: On jiawu day, in grateful acknowledgment of accession, officials were dispatched to perform sacrifices by proxy at the southern suburban altar and altars of soil and grain.

s0373.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "Formerly, court officials had one performance review every thirty months; outer appointments were full after three years.
s0373.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said: "Formerly, court officials had one performance review every 30 months; outer appointments were full after 3 years.

s0374.literal: In recent years court officials generally did not long remain in their posts, or were transferred after only a few months — unlike the settled institutions, and with no means to examine their governance record.
s0374.idiomatic: In recent years court officials generally did not long remain in their posts, or were transferred after only a few months — unlike the settled institutions, and with no means to examine their governance record.

s0375.literal: We request that the former system be restored as fitting.
s0375.idiomatic: We request that the former system be restored as fitting.

s0376.literal: " An edict: "Except for surveillance officials, other court officials may not be transferred within twenty months.
s0376.idiomatic: " An edict: "Except for surveillance officials, other court officials may not be transferred within 20 months.

s0377.literal: " Surveillance censor impeached: "Ministry of Personnel minister Balakhaqi was first appointed Shaanxi branch surveillance attendant censor, but did not go, avoiding trouble.
s0377.idiomatic: " Surveillance censor impeached: "Ministry of Personnel minister Balakhaqi was first appointed Shaanxi branch surveillance attendant censor, but did not go, avoiding trouble.

s0379.literal: On bingchen day central secretariat officials said: "We have respectfully assembled officials of the Privy Council, Censorate, Hanlin, Academy of Worthies, Kui Zhang Pavilion, Grand Ceremonies Court, and Ministry of Rites, and deliberated on the late emperor's honorific posthumous title: Emperor Yixian Jingxiao, temple name Mingzong, and national-language posthumous title: Hüdüduq Emperor.
s0379.idiomatic: On bingchen day central secretariat officials said: "We have respectfully assembled officials of the Privy Council, Censorate, Hanlin, Academy of Worthies, Kui Zhang Pavilion, Grand Ceremonies Court, and Ministry of Rites, and deliberated on the late emperor's honorific posthumous title: Emperor Yixian Jingxiao, temple name Mingzong, and national-language posthumous title: Hüdüduq Emperor.

s0380.literal: " That day the jade book and jade seal were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple according to ordinary rites.
s0380.idiomatic: " That day the jade book and jade seal were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple according to ordinary rites.

s0381.literal: Jiangxi and Huguang were ordered to transport four hundred thousand shi of grain tribute separately, to ease Jiang-Zhe popular burdens;
s0381.idiomatic: Jiangxi and Huguang were ordered to transport 400,000 shi of grain tribute separately, to ease Jiang-Zhe popular burdens;

s0382.literal: one hundred fifty thousand ingots of notes were issued to relieve Shaanxi starving people.
s0382.idiomatic: 150,000 ingots of notes were issued to relieve Shaanxi starving people.

s0383.literal: On jihai day the Celestial Consort was further enfeoffed Celestial Consort Protect-the-State Shelter-the-People Broadly Relieve Blessings and Favor Clearly Manifest; the temple plaque "Lingci" was granted, and envoys were dispatched to perform sacrifice.
s0383.idiomatic: On jihai day the Celestial Consort was further enfeoffed Celestial Consort Protect-the-State Shelter-the-People Broadly Relieve Blessings and Favor Clearly Manifest; the temple plaque "Lingci" was granted, and envoys were dispatched to perform sacrifice.

s0384.literal: Admonitions were issued regarding Metropolitan Waterworks Directorate river-defense prohibitions.
s0384.idiomatic: Admonitions were issued regarding Metropolitan Waterworks Directorate river-defense prohibitions.

s0385.literal: On xinchou day envoys were dispatched to survey and examine inner and outer commandery and district officials long in post or due for replacement through accident or vacancy; at year's end names were to be submitted to the Central Secretariat.
s0385.idiomatic: On xinchou day envoys were dispatched to survey and examine inner and outer commandery and district officials long in post or due for replacement through accident or vacancy; at year's end names were to be submitted to the Central Secretariat.

s0386.literal: The Qelir Office Colored Artisan General Directorate and its subordinate offices that had been subordinate to the Empress's Domestic Affairs Court were all made subordinate to the Stored Governance Court.
s0386.idiomatic: The Qelir Office Colored Artisan General Directorate and its subordinate offices that had been subordinate to the Empress's Domestic Affairs Court were all made subordinate to the Stored Governance Court.

s0387.literal: Grain stores of the Central Domestic Affairs Court Treasury General Directorate in Jiangnan were dispatched to the capital to assist expenditures; current fair value was verified and repaid in notes.
s0387.idiomatic: Grain stores of the Central Domestic Affairs Court Treasury General Directorate in Jiangnan were dispatched to the capital to assist expenditures; current fair value was verified and repaid in notes.

s0388.literal: Field rents allotted and granted to princes, princesses, government offices, and temples and monasteries — except that the Grand Eldest Princess of Lu was permitted to dispatch persons to collect them, the rest were all delivered to the government, and notes were given as payment at fair value.
s0388.idiomatic: Field rents allotted and granted to princes, princesses, government offices, and temples and monasteries — except that the Grand Eldest Princess of Lu was permitted to dispatch persons to collect them, the rest were all delivered to the government, and notes were given as payment at fair value.

s0389.literal: On renyin day prohibitions on Shaanxi's western mountains and marshes were relaxed and given to the people.
s0389.idiomatic: On renyin day prohibitions on Shaanxi's western mountains and marshes were relaxed and given to the people.

s0391.literal: On guimao day Daoist Miao Daoyi was ordered to establish a jiao rite at Changchun Palace.
s0391.idiomatic: On guimao day Daoist Miao Daoyi was ordered to establish a jiao rite at Changchun Palace.

s0392.literal: Qiongzhou Military-Civilian Pacification Commission was renamed Qianning Military-Civilian Pacification Commission; Ding'an County was promoted to Nanjian Prefecture, subordinate to Haibei Marshal's Headquarters; Wang Guan, chief of Nanjian cave, was appointed to administer prefectural affairs, wore a gold tally, and commanded military and civilian affairs.
s0392.idiomatic: Qiongzhou Military-Civilian Pacification Commission was renamed Qianning Military-Civilian Pacification Commission; Ding'an County was promoted to Nanjian Prefecture, subordinate to Haibei Marshal's Headquarters; Wang Guan, chief of Nanjian cave, was appointed to administer prefectural affairs, wore a gold tally, and commanded military and civilian affairs.

s0393.literal: Surveillance censor impeached: "Zhang Siming, during Renzong's reign, fawned upon powerful minister Tiemudie'er, spied between the two palaces; Renzong clearly saw his wickedness and had him demoted.
s0393.idiomatic: Surveillance censor impeached: "Zhang Siming, during Renzong's reign, fawned upon powerful minister Tiemudie'er, spied between the two palaces; Renzong clearly saw his wickedness and had him demoted.

s0394.literal: When Yingzong reigned and Tiemudie'er again became chancellor, he was again brought in as left vice chancellor; his evil ripened without repentance, and he was finally dismissed for crime.
s0394.idiomatic: When Yingzong reigned and Tiemudie'er again became chancellor, he was again brought in as left vice chancellor; his evil ripened without repentance, and he was finally dismissed for crime.

s0395.literal: Now he again occupies this post improperly — he should be removed and dismissed.
s0395.idiomatic: Now he again occupies this post improperly — he should be removed and dismissed.

s0396.literal: " An edict removed him from office.
s0396.idiomatic: " An edict removed him from office.

s0397.literal: An edict: the Minister of Punishments is to investigate and punish the unruly among the people.
s0397.idiomatic: An edict: the Minister of Punishments is to investigate and punish the unruly among the people.

s0398.literal: On jiachen day one hundred eight Uighur monks performed Buddhist rites at Xingsheng Hall.
s0398.idiomatic: On jiachen day 108 Uighur monks performed Buddhist rites at Xingsheng Hall.

s0399.literal: On wushen day the Jiang-Huai Treasury General Directorate was made subordinate to the Stored Governance Court, to supply the empress's bath-and-fief needs.
s0399.idiomatic: On wushen day the Jiang-Huai Treasury General Directorate was made subordinate to the Stored Governance Court, to supply the empress's bath-and-fief needs.

s0400.literal: Buddhist rites were performed at the Broad Cold Hall.
s0400.idiomatic: Buddhist rites were performed at the Broad Cold Hall.
